text: 好利科技公告，公司控股股东旭升亚洲投资有限公司及实际控制人汤奇青于2026年7月2日与厦门产投科技创新投资合伙企业（有限合伙）签署《股份转让协议》，旭升投资拟通过协议转让方式向产投科创转让其持有的公司3293.46万股股份（占公司总股本的18.00%）。本次权益变动完成后，公司控股股东将由旭升投资变更为产投科创，实际控制人将由汤奇青变更为厦门市财政局。今日，公司收到产投科创通知，厦门市财政局出具《关于厦门金圆投资集团有限公司收购好利科技有关事项的通知》，原则同意本次收购好利科技的方案。本次权益变动尚需取得深圳证券交易所就本次权益变动出具的合规性确认意见、
text_en: Holley Technology announced that its controlling shareholder Xusheng Asia Investment Limited and actual controller Tang Qiqing signed a Share Transfer Agreement on July 2, 2026 with Xiamen Chantou Technology Innovation Investment Partnership (Limited Partnership). Xusheng Investment plans to transfer 32,934,600 shares it holds (18.00% of the company's total share capital) to Chantou Keji Innovation by way of agreement transfer. After this equity change is completed, the company's controlling shareholder will change from Xusheng Investment to Chantou Keji Innovation, and the actual controller will change from Tang Qiqing to the Xiamen Municipal Finance Bureau. Today, the company received notice from Chantou Keji Innovation that the Xiamen Municipal Finance Bureau issued the Notice on Matters Concerning Xiamen Jinyuan Investment Group Co., Ltd.'s Acquisition of Holley Technology, in principle approving the plan for this acquisition of Holley Technology. This equity change still requires the Shenzhen Stock Exchange to issue a compliance confirmation opinion on this equity change,
